items.text: The process that supplies this table's real offer details stopped updating it in early 2023. Since then, only placeholder-creating processes have written to the table.
Three columns (CLIENT_OFFER_ID, BUYER_ID, SCORE_CARD_ID) are completely empty across every row in this table
A related backup table (AMS_OFFER_DIM_BAK) also stopped updating around the same time, two days before this table's real data feed stopped. No process referencing this backup table has been found.

One of the loading files carries an internal warning about an incomplete step, but that step is just unused logging, not the actual data extract. It does not explain why the table's real data stopped updating in 2023.
The staging table behind this dimension does not record a per-row update time, so its last recorded activity date is the only available signal for how fresh it is
One of the placeholder-creating processes marks its rows with a third status value ('0'), outside the usual Yes/No convention used elsewhere
